name: Anhui Honglu Steel Construction (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Honglu Steel Construction (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of steel structural components and enclosure products in China and internationally. The company offers high-rise steel structures; electric single girder and electric hoist bridge cranes; and supporting products, including welding wires, polyurethane boards, steel truss floor decks, galvanized parts, precast concrete components, and pipes. It is also involved in steel trading; construction; transportation; and software development.
